reels.title: Bandhani Lehenga & Bridal Swag
reels.logNote: Our beautiful client showing off her incredible style and swag in our bespoke champagne gold silk lehenga. The heavily embellished vibrant red Bandhani dupatta adds the perfect traditional touch to her ultra-cool, modern aesthetic. We love seeing our pieces worn with such confidence!

reels.title: Midnight Black Indo-Western Co-ord
reels.logNote: Elegance redefined for the evening! Our gorgeous client looks absolutely stunning in this bespoke all-black Indo-Western co-ord set. Featuring a structured blazer-style crop top with heavily embellished sleeves and a beautifully draped skirt with an intricately hand-embroidered waistline, this outfit is the ultimate choice for a cocktail night or reception.

reels.title: Pastel Mint Pre-Draped Saree
reels.logNote: A stunning custom-made pre-draped saree in a soothing pastel mint shade. The blouse features delicate floral threadwork and full sleeves, creating a highly elegant and modern silhouette perfect for daytime celebrations.

reels.title: Fuchsia Pink Leheriya Cape Saree
reels.logNote: A bold and contemporary take on heritage fashion. This stunning fuchsia pink ensemble features a pre-draped silhouette, beautifully cinched with a hand-embroidered belt. It is elevated by a sheer, flowing Leheriya cape jacket adorned with heavy floral borders and playful bell sleeves.

A bright and vibrant yellow draped saree designed for the modern woman. Featuring elegant cascading ruffles and exquisite floral vine hand-embroidery along the borders, this outfit is the perfect blend of playful energy and traditional craftsmanship.
reels.title: Vibrant Yellow Ruffle Saree
Bespoke 3D Gotta Lehenga
reels.logNote: Our beautiful client @me_mehak24 exudes grace in her bespoke Lehenga, intricately handcrafted with 3D Gotta flowers and adorned with a pure Bandhani Gaji Silk Dupatta. A perfect fusion of heritage and modern elegance.
